heading: Threat model
body: `bare-type` is one of the addons Bare compiles into its binary, so every Bare process has it, sealed or not, and it inherits [Bare's threat model](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md). The module's own [threat model](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-type/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md), added in v1.2.0, says where it sits in that one. It only reports what a value is, across realms, and reaches and keeps nothing, so it has the smallest surface of the builtins. The risk is in the C that walks values an attacker built, proxies and revoked proxies included. Seeing across realms is not a hole, because a realm is not a wall in Bare.
